usedFor: Google Search Console tells Google about your sites, and “Submit Sitemap” and “Inspect Index” keep pages found.

bestTemplate.name: “Submit Sitemap” in Google Search Console
bestTemplate.why: It prompts Google to crawl a sitemap URL for the selected site.

watchOut: “Delete Site” and “Delete Sitemap” remove items from the connected account, so check them before a step runs.
